upstream.description: Enterprise-grade AI safety patterns for customer support workflows: deterministic classification with LLM fallbacks, guarded RAG with trust scoring, and human-in-the-loop approval with full audit trails

classification.analysis: A Node.js reference architecture demonstrating production-grade AI safety patterns for customer-support automation: a three-stage pipeline (deterministic classification with LLM confidence scoring and rule-based fallback, trust-scored guarded RAG against a knowledge base, and mandatory human-in-the-loop approval) with a full audit trail. It targets engineers designing safe LLM-driven support workflows, using Anthropic's Claude API with a zero-setup JSON file backend or an optional transactional Postgres backend, a colorized CLI demo, and a local operator dashboard web UI. Notably it degrades gracefully to a rule-based fallback when no API key is configured, and enforces audit-trail immutability via a Postgres trigger.

use_cases.title: Prototype a safe AI customer-support triage pipeline with human approval on high-risk actions
Add trust-scored RAG filtering to prevent knowledge-base poisoning in a support bot
Reference a compliance-ready audit trail pattern for LLM-driven decision systems
Fall back to deterministic rule-based classification when no LLM API key is present
